title: i18n: a tenant-rewritten validation rule message loses to the packaged translation under a non-default locale, on both the refusal and /meta — apply ADR-0029 D9.2a to both readers
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured by contract review 6467333940 on PR #27202 (#27135), flag F1. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and the grade.

**Symptom.** Take a tenant who rewrote a validation rule's message in an authored overlay layer (ADR-0029 D9), using the same rule name. Under a non-default locale, that tenant sees the **packaged** translation instead of their own rewrite, in two places:
- the server's refusal: `authoredRuleMessage` in `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` (~L3767) applies the catalog entry unconditionally;
- `/meta` and the public form: since PR #27202, `translateObject` overlays `validations[].message` with the same flat `catalog ?? document`, so that both agree.

The #8284 rule, "an explicit override beats a packaged default", holds on neither surface for rule messages. The refusal half predates #27202. The `/meta` half follows from #27202 keeping the two readers identical. That was a declared deviation, judged right by the review, because fixing one reader alone would re-open #27135's split.

**Expected.** Apply ADR-0029 D9.2a to BOTH readers in one change:
- The validator compares the rule's message against the packaged owner's rule; the registry already holds `getPackagedObjectBase`. It applies the packaged translation only when the served message is the packaged one.
- The `/meta` overlay (`translateObjectValidations` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) follows the same `valueOverridesPackagedBase` convention its siblings (`description`, `inlineTitle`, `listViews`) use.
- `/meta` and the refusal still show one string for one rule and locale. Pin both readers together.

**Business reason.** A tenant who reworded a packaged rule's message for their own users sees it reverted to the vendor's translation as soon as a user's locale differs from the default.

**Dedupe.** `search_issues` on this repo (open): "D9.2a validation message packaged base override" returned nothing. "authoredRuleMessage tenant rewrite translation" returned only #27135 (the source). **New.**
